description: This file implements tracing and event logging functionalities, including writing trace events to files, managing trace files with splitting, and formatting trace events for output. It defines classes and functions for handling trace events, extended trace events, and resource usage events, with support for logging and file output.

classes.name: event_trace_writer
classes.description: Handles writing trace events to files, managing file splitting, and event queuing.

classes.name: trace_event_extended
classes.description: Extended trace event with CPU, thread name, and duration information.

classes.name: instant_trace_event_extended
classes.description: Extended instant trace event with CPU, thread name, and timestamp.

classes.name: rusage_trace_event_extended
classes.description: Extended resource usage trace event including resource usage differences.

methods.name: ocudu::open_trace_file
methods.description: Opens a new trace file for logging, initializing the trace file writer.

methods.name: ocudu::is_trace_file_open
methods.description: Checks if a trace file is currently open.

methods.name: formatted_date
methods.description: Returns an approximate formatted timestamp for a given trace point.
